scope: Snapshot costs retained. Fixed-set counts price one pass; debate uses model-specific observed counts. No blanket repeat multiplier or infrastructure/judge surcharge.

vals_terminal_bench_2_1.evidence: Background identifies 89 terminal tasks in version 2.1.

vals_legal_research.evidence: Dataset: 413 questions split into 5 public, 200 validation and 208 test; leaderboard uses test only.

vals_srebench.evidence: Methodology: 262 evaluation instances with six grading subgoals each. Spend is per instance; 1572 is the grading subgoal count.

vals_emb.evidence: Dataset: 51 held-out questions in both Template and Scratch modes. Overall cost averages the two modes; 51 x 2 = 102 executions.

vals_fabv2.evidence: Dataset: 450 held-out questions. Three independent runs contribute to reported scores; this count prices one pass, not all three.

vals_proof_bench.evidence: Private test has 100 problems. Costs average all 100, including incomplete problems.

vals_terminal_bench_science.evidence: Background and scoring specify all 70 tasks in upstream v0.1.0.

vals_vibe_code.evidence: Page reports canonical v1.1 test results. Linked paper Table 3 specifies 50 held-out applications; browser workflows are grading units.
vals_vibe_code.caveat: Generation API estimate; browser evaluation costs are discussed separately in the paper.

vals_programbench.evidence: Results identify 200 reconstruction tasks; hidden test branches are grading units.

vals_tax_agent_bench.evidence: Dataset and results identify the private 193-question test split.

vals_ioi.evidence: Methodology: six problems per year across 2024-2026. Results explicitly describe eighteen problems.

vals_medscribe.evidence: Background specifies 100 rubrics; methodology describes one rubric per transcript and one generated note per transcript. The 80-transcript realism study is separate.
vals_medscribe.status_detail: Derived count: one rubric per transcript.

vals_code_migration.evidence: 30 CLI repositories x four target languages plus 10 COBOL-to-Java tasks. Displayed average weights repositories 3:1; sum 120 x CLI cost + 10 x COBOL cost for execution spend.

lech_debate.evidence: Each completed pair group contains two side-swapped debates. Use model-specific pair groups from the same cached rating report.
lech_debate.caveat: Approximate chart costs (+/-10%); debater-side spend only, excluding opponents, judges, failed attempts and placement overhead.

matharena.evidence: IRT capability and weighted expected cost across competitions do not define a common observed run. Need matching task weights and evaluated coverage; summing competition sizes is not valid.

agent_arena.evidence: Median cost over a 14-day window; ranking sessions and priced sessions differ. Median times count is not total. Need matched run scope and summed cost.

aicd.evidence: Leaderboard has six project columns / 60 points; linked methodology describes five projects / 40 points. Four reliability projects have five attempts each; full prompt count and cost denominator remain unverified.

vals_hlab.evidence: Page uses a held-out set without stating its size. Public repository includes other splits and extensions; two judges do not imply two agent executions. Need official held-out manifest.

vals_medcode.evidence: Page states 2755 diagnosis codes, not verified patient-record prompts. Records can have multiple codes; need evaluated record count.

vals_sage.evidence: Overall is class-balanced over Automata, Linear Algebra and PDEs; public Calculus excluded. Need matching per-class test counts and cost aggregation weights.
